snippet_primary: "One of the issues that buyers encounter when downloading files is running out of download credits. A message similar to the one below will appear notifying you that you have already exceeded your download attempts.\n\nThis can easily be resolved by simply resetting your credits for this transaction. All you need to do is click the \"Reset download credits\" button and enter the email you used to make this purchase. [...] If you have any extensions or add-ons running in the background (e.g. ad blockers or VPN), you might run into some issues whilst downloading large files. [...] Another reason that may be preventing you from successfully downloading the files is your internet speed."
subject_exact: Payhip help center describes download credit system: buyers can exhaust download attempts; self-service reset via 'Reset download credits' button; ad blockers/VPNs and internet speed also cause download issues
local_qualifiers: Payhip download credit system: buyers have limited download attempts per purchase
self-service reset: 'Reset download credits' button, requires purchase email
known download issues: ad blockers, VPN extensions, slow internet speed
parser_notes: Payhip help center (updated October 21, 2025). Official documentation on download credit limits for buyers. Covers self-service credit reset and common download failure causes. October 2025 date noted; may not reflect current state.
